annotations.title: Get a running accessibility check result (free)

description: Free, never counted. Returns the result of a check_accessibility job that was still running (status running/queued + job_id). Waits up to about 25 s; call again if it is still running. Results are kept 15 minutes. Example: {"job_id":"..."}.
name: accessibility_result
title: Get a running accessibility check result (free)
